criteria: The radical Russian intelligentsia of roughly 1840-1870 who preceded the Narodniks: the Westernizing and utopian-socialist critics, journalists and publicists around Belinsky, Herzen, Ogarev, Chernyshevsky, Dobrolyubov and Pisarev, whose journals Sovremennik and Kolokol promoted democracy, anti-serfdom and socialist ideas. Slavophiles, liberals, Vekhi and religious philosophers, and anyone already in the narodnik collection are excluded.
